ayahs.1: Aap kah dijiye! ke main subah ke Rabb ki panah mein aata hoon.
ayahs.2: Har us cheez ke shar se jo us ne paida ki hai.
ayahs.3: Aur andheri raat ki tareeki ke shar se jab us ka andhera phail jaaye.
ayahs.4: Aur girah (laga kar un) mein phoonkne waliyon ke shar se (bhi).
ayahs.5: Aur hasad karne wale ki burai se bhi jab woh hasad kare.
